interface.title: PEM Electrolysis Cell Designer (PEM-EC Designer)
interface.field: Electrochemical engineering / hydrogen production (proton-exchange-membrane water electrolysis)
interface.stage_of_work: Early design and what-if exploration: choosing cell materials, sizing a stack and checking the operating point before building anything or running experiments
interface.what_it_is_for: Pick membrane, catalysts, gas diffusion layers (GDLs) and bipolar plate from a literature-referenced preset library, set operating conditions and stack geometry, and read the modelled polarization curve and stack performance figures (KPIs): voltage, power, H2 output, efficiency and waste heat.

data.note: All results come from the built-in physics model and preset material library, recomputed whenever a sidebar control changes. No file upload was possible. The only uploader ('Load assembly JSON') is on the Assembly tab, and that tab never draws (see not_done), so example_assembly.json, bernt_2020_fig1.csv and zimmer_2026_fig1c.csv were never used. The app crashes on every run with 'ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found 1.26.4' at streamlit_app.py line 357 (st.dataframe of the voltage-decomposition table). This is a fault in the run environment, not the tool: requirements.txt pins numpy<2, but the installed pyarrow needs NumPy 2, so every st.dataframe call fails (streamlit_app.py:357, 493, 578). Only what is drawn before line 357 works: the sidebar, the five-number KPI header and the Polarization chart. A fresh session on localhost:8501 crashed the same way (screens/035.webp).
